alerts.title: Heavy Traffic and Limited Parking Expected
alerts.description: High visitation is expected throughout the holiday weekend. Parking lots at popular trailheads and visitor destinations may fill by mid-morning. To prevent traffic backups and unsafe conditions, some parking areas may close temporarily when full. Visitors should plan for delays, arrive early, and consider less-visited areas of the park. Parking along roadways is only permitted in designated areas.

alerts.title: Oasis of Mara Trail Partial Closure
alerts.description: Due to a heavy flooding event, the Oasis of Mara Trail is closed past the Oasis.

alerts.title: Inaccurate Third-Party Apps
alerts.description: Some third-party hiking apps are providing inaccurate trail and safety information to users. Please use the official NPS app for accurate information.
